locator.section: web/www/missa/Latin/Sancti/10-11.txt [Secreta] (lines 46-47); web/www/horas/Latin/Commune/C10.txt [Secreta] (lines 216-217); web/www/horas/Latin/Commune/C11.txt [Secreta] (lines 400-402); web/www/missa/Latin/Ordo/Prayers.txt [Per Dominum] (lines 95-97); Mass Ordo Secret/Preface context at lines196–202

entries.claim: The pinned Mass data give this exact inherited proper plus the Mass Per Dominum conclusion and separate Amen response, as a derived literal comparison. The Common lacks the printed apposition Unigeniti tui Matris and eundem. Agreement with every selected word, literal import fidelity and genealogical independence are not claimed.

locator.section: Latin Mass Ordo lines196–202: Secreta call and audible final conclusion; Prayers [Per Dominum] lines95–97: separate Amen

entries.claim: The pinned Mass Ordo places the Secret before the Preface and identifies its final audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum; its Per Dominum prayer block has a separate response Amen. This derived control is not independent authority for every choir or faithful participation assignment.
RG 115 a prints the full base conclusion to which RG 115 b refers. In this composite it supplies the continuation after the Per eundem opening, not a second independent witness.
RG 115 b prescribes Per eundem Dominum nostrum when the Father is addressed and the Son is mentioned earlier, then refers to the preceding formula for the remaining words.

The Benziger 1962 printing supplies the proper Secret, including Unigeniti tui Matris, and the abbreviated Per eundem Dominum cue. Its full conclusion is supplied from the separately cited RG 115 b and referenced RG 115 a formula.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
